name: smwsprites-sweep-blaster
title: Sweep Blaster
description:
This Bill-Blaster like enemy will fall down from the top of the screen endlessly and shoot at the player when they are vertically aligned. It also acts as a semi-solid platform!

It won't shoot if the player is too close, though.

If you set the Extra Bit, it will stick to the right side of the screen, which is a viable substitute for the vanilla Bullet generator in things like autoscrollers. This set of behaviors from the Sweep Blaster is a lot less polite, though, and will shoot no matter if the player is close or not.
